0022600131.text: The Trail Blazers (1-0, second in the Northwest, 0.5 games back and fourth in the West) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (1-0, second in the Pacific and fifth in the West), with both teams unbeaten so far this season. Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), all listed as out. The Trail Blazers won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and beat the Lakers 132-116 in their last meeting in Portland, while no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
